evidence_summary: Both candidates had positive three-standard-deviation excursions in 90 of 100 runs.

evidence_summary: Positive runwise Spearman counts were 78 and 76 for levels and 75 and 81 for changes versus 73 reported.
main_caveat: Completed-fit and exact-H label coupling make this retrospective only.

evidence_summary: Positive significant counts were 45 and 44 for levels and 55 and 50 for changes versus 54 reported.
main_caveat: Unadjusted runwise p-values ignore serial dependence and the paper is inconsistent about level versus change.

evidence_summary: Mean runwise Spearman values were 0.0611-0.0749 across candidates and analyses versus 0.139 reported.
main_caveat: The sign reproduces but magnitude is smaller; completed fits are retrospective.

evidence_summary: One-sample mean-correlation diagnostics were significantly positive for both candidates in both level and change analyses and dependence-aware controls agreed.
main_caveat: Support is label-coupled and retrospective and does not imply incremental information or causality.

evidence_summary: Replicator-state means were higher in 74-86 runs across candidates and level/change analyses versus 57 reported.
main_caveat: The exact-H current-state label differs from the historical post-fission label.

evidence_summary: All retained point-pooled and run-summary Mann-Whitney reconstructions gave higher replicator emergence with p<0.001.
main_caveat: The paper does not identify which aggregation scope it used so exact forensic identity is underdetermined.

evidence_summary: Fisher-combined diagnostics gave p far below 0.001 for both candidates and both analyses.
main_caveat: This paper-like diagnostic inherits serial dependence and exact-H label coupling.

evidence_summary: Raw Ljung-Box rejection counts were 82 and 79 versus 86 reported.
main_caveat: The paper does not report its Ljung-Box lag.

evidence_summary: Median raw Ljung-Box p-values were 2.66e-8 and 7.01e-6 and therefore strongly indicated dependence though not the reported 2.07e-51 magnitude.
main_caveat: The paper does not report its lag or exact aggregation.

evidence_summary: Differenced trajectories rejected temporal independence in 100 of 100 runs for each candidate.
main_caveat: The exact paper lag remains unavailable even though the reported count is matched.

evidence_summary: PhiRL did not outperform composition change in either completed-fit candidate and no p<0.01 advantage occurred.

evidence_summary: Candidate 2 had a tiny directional completed-fit accuracy edge over raw counts but candidate 3 did not and neither comparison had p<0.01.

evidence_summary: PhiRL did not outperform molecular flux in either candidate at the paper-like significance criterion.

evidence_summary: The majority dummy slightly exceeded PhiRL median accuracy in both candidates.
main_caveat: Balanced accuracy was approximately 0.5 and specificity approximately zero.
